settings.checkpoint_rule: one shared epoch; per-component validation-only gate; task-normalized gain averaged equally across components and configurations; ties fewer switches then earlier epoch
settings.evaluation_cache: reuse unchanged inherited individual when exact chromosome/scenario key is still valid; new constructed solutions are charged, even if an earlier unrelated individual had the same chromosome
settings.training_balance: each gradient update equally averages 3 components x 9 configurations; same batch-count per minibatch
settings.loss: legal-pair magnitude-weighted softplus ranking; no regression term
settings.scope: shared supervision only; terminal joint PPO follows a separate stage
settings.historical_feedback_role: quick pretraining diagnostic only; full model refits scaling and trains fresh using full-budget data
settings.initialization: preserve Base capacity and greedy seed slots; Directed/K8 only on remaining random slots
settings.cm_collection: one Base trajectory shared by C and M per instance; private audit randomness; rule candidate included

coverage.use: frozen supervised model for full-budget joint evaluation / future PPO

normalization.outside_reference: points outside reference contribute no HV; objective coordinates are not clipped

loss: legal-pair magnitude-weighted softplus ranking; NO regression; task/configuration equal

pilot.reward: terminal HV(policy) minus terminal HV(frozen shared greedy), same training instance/algorithm seed/scenarios; frozen training normalization
pilot.advantage: paired terminal return minus old critic, standardized per component with equal episode weights, fixed for this update
pilot.weighting: each optimizer step averages I/C/M losses equally; episodes are sampled equally within each component
pilot.critic: value head learns paired terminal return; critic gradient does not modify shared actor representation
pilot.tuning: first validation instance of each S0/S4/S8, all three existing validation seeds, greedy deployment
pilot.confirmation: second validation instance of each S0/S4/S8, same three seeds; chosen nonzero checkpoint evaluated greedy and sampled; sampled u0 control
pilot.selection: configuration-equal paired final HV delta on tuning; record both overall best including u0 and best nonzero checkpoint; evaluate nonzero regardless of sign
pilot.first_preview: two u0 replay checks, six paired training searches, first three tuning comparisons; continue fixed schedule
pilot.qualification: Post-hoc development pilot. No screen instances used for fitting or selection. Validation instances have been used in earlier development; confirmation is not a new independent final test. No outcome-driven instance, seed, budget or version changes.
